audience: vendors that sell through RetailCloud and manage stock, orders and shipping there

useCases.title: Find the products that are low on stock
useCases.text: List your products with their variants, SKUs, prices, cost and inventory. Check which products are published to the storefront.

useCases.title: Review the orders that have not shipped yet
useCases.text: List the orders to fulfill, with their UIID, shipping address, SKU and quantity. Look up the purchase order that holds an order by its UIID.

useCases.title: Stop sales of a SKU or change its stock quantity
useCases.text: Set the available quantity of a SKU. Set it to 0 to stop sales of that SKU. Check the open orders before you change inventory.

useCases.title: Set new cost or suggested prices for SKUs
useCases.text: Update the cost or suggested retail price of variants by SKU. A cost increase removes the product from the site until the buyer approves it.

useCases.title: Add tracking numbers to orders that shipped
useCases.text: Add the tracking number and carrier to shipped orders and mark them shipped. Use this only after the order has shipped.

useCases.title: Add products and variants to the catalog
useCases.text: Create new products, or update products still in offered status. Add variants to an existing product by giving the SKU of one of its variants.
